_meta.name: Sketch to Render
_meta.description: Transforms an uploaded architectural sketch or massing study into a photorealistic concept render guided by the source image (FLUX 3 Image Klein).
_meta.license_notes: FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B, step-distilled, int8): FLUX Kommunity License - free commercial use only for individuals/organisations under US$5M annual revenue; larger organisations need a licence from Black Forest Labs. Text encoder qwen3vl_4b and flux2-vae under their own licences. Runs fully offline.

inputs.text: Transform the uploaded architectural sketch or massing study into a polished photorealistic architectural visualization. Use the sketch as the primary design guide. Preserve its principal outline, building massing, visible floor levels, proportions, circulation, openings, major structural positions, and camera/perspective where shown. Develop believable architectural materials, glass and metal façades, realistic daylight and shadows, refined landscape planting, and a coherent site context. Interpret unclear details conservatively; do not add unnecessary floors or major design elements that conflict with the sketch. Produce a professional architectural concept render, not a drawing with annotations.

unreadable sketch marks, distorted building outline, warped perspective, random extra floors, missing major openings, impossible structure, duplicated columns, messy annotations, text overlay, watermark, blurry image, low detail, oversaturated colors, cartoon style, excessive visual clutter
